[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (xs: List Int) : List Int :=
match xs with
| [] => []
| x0::xs' =>
  xs'.zipWith (fun x n => n * x) (range xs'.length).map (fun i => i + 1)
end
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma list_zip_with_range_length (xs: List Int) (n: Nat) :
  (xs.zipWith (fun x n => n * x) (range n).map (fun i => i + 1)) = xs.take n.zipWith (fun x i => i * x) (range n).map (fun i => i + 1) :=
by
  induction' xs generalizing n
  simp
  rename_i head tail ih
  simp
  simp [←List.zipWith_cons, ih]
  simp [List.range_cons, List.zipWith_cons, List.zipWith_nil, List.zipWith_cons]
  simp [List.take_cons, List.take_nil, List.take_cons]
  simp [List.zipWith_nil, List.zipWith_cons]
  simp [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.map_cons]
